_comment: Fresh install seeds this file as config.json. Track it only when it contains project settings and environment-variable references. Fill via ws-configure-project. toolsFile points to the tool vocabulary all agents use.

pathTokens._comment: skillsRoot is fixed; sharedDir is the relocatable hub root (repo-relative, contained; bootstrap config stays at .ws/config.json). Expand brace tokens before Read/Grep/Shell. Full contract: {skillsRoot}/ws-shared/runtime/tools.md § Path tokens. plansDir/reviewsDir still resolve from plans.dir / reviews.dir.

stack.description: Node 22 skill package / agent harness (workflow-skills upstream)

layers.name: installer-cli
layers.role: Upstream authoring CLI, integrity, site builder

domain.model: Agent skill harness — portable SKILL.md workflows, providers, and shared hub

providers._comment: active = work-item/spec source (github | azure-devops | local). scm = PR/thread host (github | azure-devops only; never local). Hybrid example: active=local + scm=github (local specs, GitHub PRs). If scm omitted: when active is github|azure-devops → scm=active; when active=local → infer from project.repoUrl host (github.com → github; dev.azure.com|visualstudio.com → azure-devops) or STOP and set scm explicitly. LEGACY: omit this entire providers block to infer active from issueTrackers.*.enabled (GitHub if enabled, else Azure DevOps, else local).

azureDevOps._comment: Set enabled: true and fill org/project. Put token in ADO_PAT (or AZURE_DEVOPS_PAT) — never commit it.

dagThresholds._comment: If ALL criteria are within limits, execMode is sequential (skip DAG).

defaults._comment_autoload: When true, consumer intends repo-root AGENTS.md to autoload Always-applied skills from {sharedDir}/autoload.md. Omitted/missing/false → effective false; harness fails closed only when true.
defaults._comment_enableDag: When true, break plan into parallel tasks executed by subagents. When false (default), execute tasks sequentially one by one in serial order.
defaults._comment_verboseMode: Seeded true by ws-configure-project. Runtime: explicit true prints a reasoned start-of-step preview; omitted or false → silent.
defaults._comment_deliveryCommitArtifacts: Step 8 delivery commit includes under {us-dir}. Defaults: refined plan on; delivery result off (behavior change vs legacy always plan+result); opt-ins false. Omitted object/keys at read time merge to these AC1 defaults — never silently revert to always staging plan+result.
defaults._comment_models: Resolve order when --model is blank: stepModels[role|N] → active preset steps[role|N] → top-level phase key → preset phase key → session. Token "current" uses session currentModel (no fallthrough). Empty string falls through. Unknown modelsPreset → preset "default" if present, else legacy four keys. Fix-PR roles bypass numeric Step 9: fixPrPlan → reviewerModel; fixPrExec → executionModel. Lite ignores testingModel and all role keys, including fixPrPlan/fixPrExec, while preserving inline plan-before-edit order. Presets are lean phase-key bundles without a steps map; put per-step or per-role overrides in top-level stepModels. The default preset is all current (session-only safe fallback). Switch modelsPreset to a named bundle (cursor, deepseek, opencode, cheap, muse-spark) for host-specific models.
defaults._comment_specializedSubagents: Opt-in host projections. enabled true compiles .cursor/agents/ws-step-*.md. directory can be 'userLevel' ($HOME/.cursor/agents, etc) or 'projectLevel' (dynamically loaded from project relative). Step 5 is product-tree readonly in the prompt; never host Ask-mode readonly.

plans._comment_plansDir: Resolve skill token {plansDir} from plans.dir (there is no separate plansDir key).
plans._comment_specsDir: Human-facing local specs dir. Skill token {specsDir} ← plans.specsDir (default .agents/specs). Prefer existing repo-root specs/ when already present. ws-spec-write writes here only; workflow step-00 copies under {plansDir}/{slug}/ come from providers or ws-spec-provider-local register.
plans._comment_enforceSpecPrefixOrdering: When true, new spec-of-record writes and organizer apply NNNN-{slug}.spec.md under {specsDir}. Omitted, non-boolean, or missing config safely resolves to false until ws-spec-write persists this key. Seeded true here because this board already uses NNNN- filenames.

reviews._comment: Optional local review artifact root (fix-pr / ws-goal-fix-pr round reports).

preview._comment: Optional. /ws-preview runs preview.dryRunCommand from the consumer repo root — no packaged reviewer backend. Prefer /ws-configure-project --section preview (infers from AGENTS.md, README, MEMORY, rules.*, package.json scripts, and local skills) or set the string below. Empty → /ws-preview stops until configured.
preview._comment_dryRunCommand: Local dry-run mirror of .github/workflows/cursor-code-review.yml via `npm run review:dry` (same engine/model/variant/stack/prompt/threshold/patterns, --dry-run, --target-branch refs/heads/main, no --gh/--pr-id, so no PR threads are published). Requires network (downloads run.sh) and CURSOR_API_KEY at run time.
preview._comment_previewBeforeShip: When true (default if omitted), ws-ship-pr runs the dry-run once after commit/push and before Create PR; failures are reported, shipping continues. Explicit false disables the gate.

rules._comment: Guardrails paths. Resolve per .ws/AGENTS.md External dependencies (first match). seniorDeveloper = Delivery gate and surgical diffs (default packaged ws-senior-developer); set "" to disable or point at another guardrail; karpathyGuidelines = compatibility alias pointing to ws-senior-developer; stackFile = stack companion; changelogFile = append-only history (default under .ws/); other keys optional consumer rule paths — leave empty when unused.

tracking._comment: Upstream package keeps FEATURES.md inventory. Set featuresMdEnabled false in consumer hubs that do not use FEATURES.md.

fable._comment: Opt-in integration for fable-* skills within ws-spec-to-pr / ws-spec-to-pr-lite workflows. Master toggle must be true to enable automatic calls.
